rationale: This is a motor-vehicle collision involving damage to the policyholder's own vehicle and injury to the policyholder from the impact.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at high impact on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 AM; vehicle is totaled with severe trunk/frame damage. Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist; police report filed with other driver's insurance details. High-severity claim requiring urgent vehicle appraisal and injury assessment.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: yes; other driver's insurance info on file
